item.title: Iron County to consider proposal to rezone over 100 acres of agricultural land
item.description: A large plot of land in Iron County could be rezoned to an industrial area, with some residents concerned about the change.

item.title: Over a dozen Salt Lake Community College student-athletes to compete in 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Salt Lake Community College (SLCC) is celebrating over a dozen current or recent SLCC students who will be representing the United States in the 2026 Winter Olympics games.

item.title: Author donates to children's hospital after receiving open heart surgery at 6 years old
item.description: A local children's book author is planning to make a donation to Primary Children's Hospital to give back after everything the hospital has done for the community, including his own heart surgery when he was six years old

item.title: Local filmmakers look back on the legacy of the Sundance Film Festival in Utah
item.description: As the final Sundance Film Festival in Utah is winding down, ABC4 has taken the time to speak to a few local filmmakers and Sundance alumni about the legacy the festival will leave behind in Utah.

item.title: Bill that would end driving privilege card program for immigrants is in committee
item.description: A bill introduced by Rep. Trevor Lee (R-Davis County) that would end the driving privilege card program for immigrants is currently in the House Rules Committee, waiting to be discussed.

item.title: Millcreek residents sound off on new Parley's Canyon mining permit
item.description: Millcreek residents and leaders made their voices heard as the Department of Air Quality held a public hearing Wednesday night.

item.title: Inaugural superintendent elected by Timpanogos School Board
item.description: The Timpanogos School Board just selected their inaugural superintendent.

item.title: Family Promise of Ogden helps families in crisis take back control of their lives
item.description: Family Promise of Ogden works with their community to help families in crisis. They don't just help with physical needs, but they teach a family to be independent.

item.title: Protesters gather outside Congresswoman Celeste Maloy's town hall meeting
item.description: Protesters gathered outside of a Town Hall meeting hosted by Congresswoman Celeste Maloy on Wednesday evening.

item.title: 40 years later: The Challenger disaster and the Utah man who tried to stop it
item.description: Forty years after the Challenger disaster, the tragedy is remembered not only for the seven lives lost, but for the engineer who tried to stop the launch and was ignored.
